title: PR body's final Verification section keeps stale pre-rebase counts (22/22 render tests, 47/47 demos, 10/10 gates), contradicting its own rebase section and the actual suite
evidence:
## Verification

- `odin test core`: 236/236 (bad-frees 134 → 2 pre-existing)
- `odin test app/render`: 22/22 (7 new spawn-fx pins: clone round-trip,
  predict == actual spawn, pending-commands path, negatives, feed walk-back,
  reveal math, dedup)
- `tools/harness.sh run`: **47/47 demos green** (T1 manifests + T2 pixels +
  replay gate + fold-check)
- `tools/ci-local.sh --mac`: **10/10 gates green** (incl. input-parity 27/27)
--- vs the same file's rebase section (lines 113-114):
change — #85 only refactored the writer). Full suite: **48/48 demos green**
(47 + the new motion.dem), **11/11 CI gates green**.
detail: Spec makes the PR body the cause-document for the re-bless; post-rebase actuals (measured) are 52 app/render tests (rebase merged #82's render suite), 48 demos green, 11 CI gates. The last-word Verification section contradicts both reality and the rebase section.
recommended_fix: Update the Verification section to the post-rebase counts: app/render 52/52, harness 48/48, ci-local 11/11.
